events.event_name: Cafe Yaeji: Oatly × Yaeji Free Gochujang Latte Pop-Up
events.what_it_is: A two-day Korean-dabang-inspired cafe created by Oatly and artist/producer Yaeji.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary iced Gochujang Lattes made with espresso, Oatly Barista Edition, gochujang-vanilla base and salted vanilla cold foam, while available.
events.caveats: Free drinks are promotional inventory and should be treated as while supplies last; no reservation requirement was published in the verified sources.
events.practical_notes: Open to the public Saturday and Sunday, 9 AM–3 PM, at 48 Ludlow Street.

events.event_name: Yepoda × Sephora — The Dewy Day Tour
events.address: NYC Sephora stops; see date-specific details
events.what_it_is: Yepoda's K-beauty pop-up truck celebrating its U.S. Sephora launch, with product try-ons, games and giveaways.
events.what_is_free: Product sampling, exclusive gifts while supplies last, and chances to win Sephora gift cards and full-size products. No purchase is necessary to attend or receive the advertised freebies; separate gifts-with-purchase require qualifying spend.
events.caveats: Free gifts are while supplies last. Purchase-based GWP offers are separate from free admission/freebies. The two dates use different Sephora locations.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 19: Sephora Meatpacking, 21-27 9th Ave. Sept. 20: Sephora Union Square, 40 E 14th St. Both run 12–6 PM.

events.event_name: Max Mara Le Parfum × Macy's Sampling Pop-Up
events.what_it_is: An open-air launch activation for Max Mara Le Parfum outside Macy's Herald Square with fragrance discovery, games and giveaways.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary fragrance samples, gelato and promotional giveaways while supplies last.
events.caveats: Giveaways and samples are promotional inventory and may run out. The Eventbrite listing is hosted by Max Mara and offers free tickets.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 10 AM–6 PM, outside Macy's Herald Square at 151 W 34th St.

events.event_name: Jung Saem Mool Beauty × Van Leeuwen Mobile Pop-Up
events.brand: Jung Saem Mool Beauty × Van Leeuwen
events.address: Lexington Avenue; 557 Broadway; 21-27 9th Avenue, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: A mobile beauty-and-ice-cream activation celebrating Jung Saem Mool Beauty's Sephora launch, moving between Manhattan stops on both days.
events.what_is_free: Visitors can receive a special JSM Beauty × Van Leeuwen ice cream by following the brand; a separate social-sharing promotion offers a chance at a full-size Metal Lip Serum, limited to 200 units per day.
events.caveats: The free ice cream requires following @jsmbeauty_global. The separate full-size lip-serum social promotion is limited to 200 units per day. This is a moving activation; use the date-specific stop schedule.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 19: 11 AM–1 PM Lexington Ave; 1:30–3:30 PM at 557 Broadway; 4–7 PM at 21-27 9th Ave. Sept. 20: same first two windows, then 4–6 PM at 21-27 9th Ave.

events.what_it_is: A two-day reopening celebration for Credo Beauty's renovated SoHo boutique with gifts and product raffles.
events.what_is_free: The first 150 guests each day receive a complimentary gift with no purchase necessary; no-purchase product raffles are also advertised. A separate $100-purchase gift is available.
events.caveats: RSVP is explicitly not required and does not guarantee gift eligibility. Free gifts are first-come, first-served, limited to the first 150 guests each day and while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 11 AM–7 PM; Sunday Sept. 20, 11 AM–6 PM at 9 Prince Street.

events.what_it_is: A launch event for Magnolia Bakery and LONDONTOWN's dessert-inspired nail lakur collection.
events.what_is_free: The first 100 guests receive a free Banana Pudding and Banana Pudding lakur. After that, the nail polish is advertised as a gift with purchase while supplies last.
events.caveats: The fully free bundle is limited to the first 100 guests. Later promotional product requires a purchase and remains subject to supply.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19 beginning at 11 AM at Magnolia Bakery, 401 Bleecker St. Secondary event listings give an 11 AM–1 PM activation window.
